chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
The muʾadhdhin would come to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله in the heat at the time of salat al-zuhr, and the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله would say to him, "Let it cool, let it cool."

key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْمُؤَذِّنُ: the one who gives the call to prayer
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله delay Zuhr prayer during extreme heat?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that during intense heat, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله instructed a delay in commencing salat al-zuhr until the heat lessened. It indicates a Prophetic practice relevant to the timing and facilitation of prayer under difficult conditions.
